goal: Keep mining transaction lookups consistent with caller expectations when no mempool is loaded
Ensure callers can safely index results by position without special-casing an empty mempool
agreement: Substantive support for preserving caller indexing expectations without a mempool
Verified by running tests and checking that reverting the fix causes failures (jeanpablojp)
Prefers returning empty entries over throwing errors when no mempool is loaded (Sjors)
Agrees it preserves documented contracts better than returning an empty list (enirox001)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because callers relying on positional indexing get consistent results without a mempool
The benefit is minor since current production paths do not encounter lookups without a mempool
